title: Sources are mandatory; correction without sources is refused
subject: sources-and-corrective-path
ratio:
Author-declared ratios bind at publication as the primary reference (institutional fixation, the
tesis-jurisprudencial pattern), but a successor retains a corrective path: it may argue a declared
ratio is merely apparent and state the real one, ONLY by reinterpreting the source materials that
actually produced the original decision, with recorded reasoning, at an authority tier no lower
than the original. Because a second-degree document (a precedent) without its first-degree
sources makes founded overruling impossible, every registry record -- of any tier, of any
operation type -- MUST carry a non-empty `sources` field naming the interpretive resources
actually consulted in producing it (spec sections, prior PR-IDs, tasks, external docs by durable
identifier). A corrective reinterpretation, or an overruling/voiding act, that cites no sources is
mechanically REFUSED at publish (exit 1): correction without sources is mere disagreement, and
mere disagreement is not a recorded interpretive act this registry can adjudicate.
scope_conditions: any successor arguing a declared ratio is apparent
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the sources grammar gains kinds or the corrective refusal is relaxed by recorded amendment
validity_conditions: publish refuses a record with no sources
